0.msg: Blair!\rHurry up with that circus venue.

1.msg: Come on, #b#h0##k. \r\nI may be almighty, \nbut I don't have ALL the land types right here in my pocket, okay?!

2.msg: But wouldn't the almighty Blair... own a construction company, a construction site, and an advertising company to bring in the crowd?

3.msg:
#i3801568#
Of course. I do actually own a construction company, AND an advertising company, 
AND an animal circus. 
I can do just about anything, you know. 
If you equip the whole #bCircus Fantasy#k set and come back to me, 
I'll give you a venue, #b#h0##k.

yes.0: I'll be over here, building the venue.\r\nShow me how you look with the whole #rCircus Fantasy Set#k equipped.

0.msg: Blae hand-made me a chair last month.\nBlair is...different.

1.msg: He should study finance if he has that kind of time.\nBut no, if I told him to do that, he'd just do the opposite.\nThat's how he always been. He only makes an effort when he REALLY wants to do something.
